items.title: Is AppLovin's Lead Over Its Peers Already In The Price?
items.summary: AppLovin (APP) grows revenue faster than any peer and earns the group's highest operating margin. It also carries the highest earnings multiple, and the premium is thin: 25.5 times earnings, against 24.9 for Meta Platforms (META), which grows at less than half AppLovin's pace. What holds the multiple up is a belief about where the growth comes from.

items.title: Is The Trade Desk's Cash Worth More Than Its Lost Growth?
items.summary: The Trade Desk (TTD) trades about 89% below its two-year high, a discount typically assigned to businesses confronting prolonged contraction. Yet its free cash flow over the last twelve months is 12.1% of market value, against a 4.4% median for the S&P 500.

items.title: Trade Desk (TTD) Adds In Workflow Brand Lift Measurement Across Global Markets
items.summary: Trade Desk (NasdaqGM:TTD) is adding LoopMe's Brand Lift measurement directly into its platform for brand advertisers worldwide. The integration is designed to deliver real-time brand lift results inside existing Trade Desk workflows across multiple global markets. LoopMe's survey based Brand Lift tool allows clients to assess campaign impact on metrics such as awareness and consideration. items.title: 2 Cash-Producing Stocks Worth Your Attention and 1 We Ignore
items.summary: While strong cash flow is a key indicator of stability, it doesn’t always translate to superior returns. Some cash-heavy businesses struggle with inefficient spending, slowing demand, or weak competitive positioning.

items.title: Can Audience Unlimited Accelerate Trade Desk's Growth Momentum?
items.summary: TTD expands Audience Unlimited, using AI and simpler data pricing to boost advertiser efficiency and support more durable growth.

items.title: AppLovin vs. The Trade Desk: Analyzing Diverging Revenue Trends for These Advertising Giants
items.summary: AppLovin's revenue has nearly tripled since late 2024, while The Trade Desk's has stalled — a widening gap that raises questions about their competitive positioning.
